technology_name: Modular Onsite Wastewater Treatment Cum Resource Recovery Unit
institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
problem_solved: Treatment of organic-rich wastewater and recovery of useful resources from small establishments
description: This modular unit is designed to treat organic-rich wastewater generated from small establishments while enabling resource recovery. The system supports the production of reusable water and bioenergy and has been field tested. It is suitable for implementation in locations such as canteens, restaurants, agro-based MSMEs, and community facilities.
applications:
Restaurants, hotels, and institutional kitchens
Agro-processing units and food-based MSMEs
Residential communities and apartment complexes
Local self-government bodies and community sanitation projects
Industrial estates and decentralized wastewater management facilities
secondary_sector: Water, Environment & Waste Management, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
